top_choice_rationale: P001 (Crews, Deshaies, Ciulli) rests on an established, independently reproduced principle: a designed bifunctional molecule forms a defined ternary complex with an E3 ligase and a target, and Ciulli's structures and cooperativity analysis made this rational design rather than screening. It gives a whole community a new capability. The trio is attributable around a citation limited to designed E3 recruitment; the omissions (Sakamoto, Kim, and the glue strand of Handa, Ito, Gray) are real but defensible. P002 (Buchwald, Hartwig) is mature with a clean two-name credit but follows the 2010 cross-coupling prize and has a thinner claim to novelty, so I rank it second, still above no award.
